sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,Acting Chief Justice
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The prayer made in the instant petition is for a mandamus restraining the respondents from interfering in the possession of the petitioner over their bhumidhari land and also not compel them to execute sale deed in respect of their share in the subject land.

3. Petitioners claims that they are owners of 0.0800 hectares of land in Gata No. 1120 located at Amit Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177952595/
1 M.R.F. Centre, Ajhuwa, Tehsil Siarthu, District Kaushambi.
4.

entities.text: Amit Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The respondents require the land of the petitioners for construction of Ajhuwa bye pass road.
They are offering to the petitioners two times the circle rate.
However, the petitioners are not ready to sell their land at the amount being offered to them by the respondents.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the respondents should either pay four times the circle rate to the petitioners or not compel them to execute the sale deed of the subject land in their favour.

6. Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel has placed on record the instructions received from Executive Engineer, Provisional Division, P.W.D., Kaushambi, according to which it is not in dispute that the subject land is required by the respondents.
They are offering two times the circle rate to the petitioners but they are insisting for compensation being paid at four times the circle rate.

7. Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel could not dispute that in case the parties are unable to arrive at an amicable settlement, respondents cannot compel the petitioners to execute sale deed as it is not a case of compulsory acquisition.
8.

Accordingly, the petition is disposed by providing that the respondents shall not compel the petitioners to execute sale deeds in respect of their share in favour of the State unless they agree for the same on their free will.
However, it shall be open to the respondents to acquire the subject land by following the procedure prescribed under law.

(Kshitij Shailendra,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,ACJ.) 
Order Date :- 16.1.2024 SK
